statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery (I25.10)
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
CPT code 93271 (Cardiac event monitoring) was billed
The billed balance for this service is 337.78
The claim was denied with reason code CO-97
Cardiac event monitoring is medically necessary to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes
The denial reason is that the service is bundled into another covered procedure and is not separately payable
